name: fdr-correct
description: Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction for a batch of p-values from simultaneous hypothesis tests (e.g. many asset/timeframe/estimator cells tested at once). Given raw p-values and a significance level, returns which tests survive FDR control and each test's q-value. Use whenever you have more than a handful of p-values and need to avoid inflated false-positive rates from multiple comparisons — do not eyeball raw p-values against alpha in that situation.

pvalues.description: Raw p-values, one per hypothesis test.

rejected.description: Per test, whether it is rejected (declared a discovery) at the given FDR level. Same order as the input pvalues.

qvalues.description: Per test, the BH q-value (smallest FDR at which it would be rejected). Same order as the input pvalues.
